text.title: plan.md Structure Output Contract
text.summary: The artefact this methodology produces is a per-feature plan.md with two H2 sections — or an explicit, justified skip for a trivial feature. The JSON Schema below (draft-07) pins both outcomes.

required.field: `F0NN` id of the feature in `features/todo/` or `features/in-progress/`
true only when the feature has ≤3 tasks AND introduces no new contract
one sentence; required when skipped = true
package layout, feature-scoped API contracts, schemas, sequencing, trade-offs; required when skipped = false
wave map, task table (`T0N` id, description, deps, token estimate), risks, rollback; required when skipped = false
the plan file(s) on disk — exactly `plan.md`, never `design.md` + `implementation-plan.md`

forbidden.pattern: skipped = true with more than 3 tasks or any new contract / schema / sequencing constraint (rule r-skip-when-trivial)
skipped = true and skip_reason absent or longer than one sentence (rule r-when-in-doubt-write)
a task without a `T0N` id or without a `deps` entry (rule r-execution-plan-contents)
design.api_contracts restating a system-wide contract that already lives in project-spec/ (rule r-design-section-contents)
a cross-reference between Design and Execution Plan that points at another file (rule r-internal-anchors)

list.item: Exactly one file, `plan.md`, with exactly two H2 sections — or no file and a one-sentence skip reason for a ≤3-task, no-new-contract feature.
`## Design` covers package layout, feature-scoped contracts, schemas, sequencing (and trade-offs for non-obvious decisions).
`## Execution Plan` has a wave map, a task table with `T0N` ids / deps / token estimates, risks, and rollback.
No contract in `## Design` duplicates project-spec/; cross-references are in-file anchors.
No forbidden pattern matches; the record validates against the schema above.
